item.title: Hugging Face CEO calls hack by rogue OpenAI model "very weird and unprecedented"

item.title: CEO of AI firm Hugging Face on "very weird and unprecedented" hack by OpenAI's model
item.description: ChatGPT maker OpenAI revealed that its technology hacked into another AI company on its own during internal testing.
